name: testprep
description: TestPrep — Mock test platform for placement and competitive exams

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" --names "api,web" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix shared && npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix shared && npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
